p: Harpurhey sits along Rochdale Road in north Manchester, and the North City Shopping Centre is the area's main hub, with the market, supermarket and local shops all in one place.

Queen's Park, one of Manchester's oldest public parks, is close by and makes a nice green break. Manchester city centre is only a short bus or tram ride away, so it's easy to pair a visit with a trip into town, and Heaton Park, with its boating lake, hall and acres of space for the kids to run about, is a short drive further north. Admiral itself is an adult gaming centre, strictly 18+, so it's not part of the family plan. North City is a practical, everyday sort of place, with the shops, cafés and takeaways right there when you want a bite.
